name: signalforge
description: SignalForge AI — BNB Hack autonomous trading agent platform

scripts.setup: npm run install:all && cp -n backend/.env.example backend/.env 2>/dev/null; cp -n frontend/.env.example frontend/.env.local 2>/dev/null; echo Setup complete.
scripts.dev: npx concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.twak:wallet: bash -c 'set -a && source <(grep -E "^TWAK_" backend/.env | sed "s/#.*//") && set +a && npx @trustwallet/cli wallet "$@"' --
